## Company Overview / 公司概况
**English:**
SKEQI (思客琦) is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production and sales of intelligent equipment, providing customers with overall intelligent manufacturing solutions centred on intelligent equipment [1]. The company is deeply rooted in the new energy intelligent equipment field, and its products cover cell assembly, module formation, PACK packaging and battery recycling/disassembly [1][3]. It positions itself as a leading module/PACK whole-line integrator in the new energy industry [1]. SKEQI has won multiple national and provincial honours, including the National May 1st Labour Certificate, the National Specialised and Sophisticated “Little Giant” Enterprise, the National Service-oriented Manufacturing Demonstration Enterprise, the National High-tech Enterprise, and the Fujian Province Manufacturing Single Champion [3]. **Verified**

**中文：**
思客琦（SKEQI）是一家专业从事智能装备研发、生产和销售的高新技术企业，为客户提供以智能装备为核心的智能制造整体解决方案 [1]。公司深度扎根新能源智能装备领域，产品涵盖电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解等电池制造流程 [1][3]。公司定位为新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线集成商 [1]。思客琦先后获得全国五一劳动奖状、国家专精特新“小巨人”企业、国家服务型制造示范企业、国家级高新技术企业、福建省制造业单项冠军等国家级与省部级荣誉 [3]。**Verified**

## Core Business / 核心业务
**English:**
SKEQI’s core business is providing intelligent equipment and overall intelligent manufacturing solutions, primarily focused on new energy intelligent equipment (cell assembly, module formation, PACK packaging, battery recycling/disassembly) [1][3]. It also provides industrial digital software and services, intelligent logistics, laser application technology, industrial non-destructive testing, precision manufacturing, and automobile & component production lines [1]. **Verified**

**中文：**
思客琦的核心业务是为客户提供以智能装备为核心的智能制造整体解决方案，主要聚焦于新能源智能装备（电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解）[1][3]。此外，公司还提供工业数字化软件及服务、智能物流、激光应用技术、工业无损检测、精密制造、汽车与零部件产线等业务 [1]。**Verified**

## Products & Services / 产品与服务
**English:**
- **New Energy Intelligent Equipment:** module/PACK whole-line solutions covering cell assembly, module formation, PACK packaging and battery recycling/disassembly [1][3].
- **琦航数字工厂系统 (QIHANG Digital Factory System):** a self-developed 5G industrial management system that includes WMS, MES, supply chain management, and big-data visualisation dashboards, enabling full-process digital control and visualisation of production [1].
- **科派乐 Intelligent Logistics:** provides intelligent conveying, handling, warehousing and non-standard automation systems for new energy, automotive, 3C electronics, etc., under the independent brand “科派乐” [1].
- **Laser Application Technology:** one-stop laser solutions focusing on laser welding, laser energy control and laser shaping technologies [1].
- **Industrial Non-Destructive Testing:** high-end 2D/3D X-ray intelligent inspection equipment for new energy batteries, electronic semiconductor welding defects, automotive parts, aerospace, etc. [1].
- **Precision Intelligent Manufacturing:** precision machining, product processing, mould manufacturing, and production of industrial equipment parts, moulds, precision plastics, hardware, battery components, and electrical components [1].
- **Automobiles and Components:** flexible, automated and intelligent production lines for body parts, chassis parts and body-in-white welding, serving automotive parts manufacturers and OEMs [1]. **Verified**

**中文：**
- **新能源智能装备：** 模组/PACK整线解决方案，涵盖电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解等 [1][3]。
- **琦航数字工厂系统：** 自主研发的5G工业管理系统，包含WMS、MES、供应链管理及大数据可视化看板，实现生产全流程数字化管控与可视化呈现 [1]。
- **科派乐智能物流：** 以智能输送系统为核心，提供智能搬运、仓储及非标自动化系统，服务新能源、汽车制造、3C电子等行业，拥有独立品牌“科派乐” [1]。
- **激光应用技术：** 一站式激光解决方案，聚焦激光焊接、激光能量控制及激光整形三大核心技术 [1]。
- **工业无损检测：** 高端（2D/3D）X射线智能检测设备，应用于新能源电池、电子半导体焊接缺陷、汽车零部件、航空航天等领域 [1]。
- **精密智造：** 精密加工、产品加工和模具制造，涵盖工业设备零部件、模具、精密塑胶、五金配件、电池零部件、电器元件等 [1]。
- **汽车与零部件：** 为汽车零部件及主机厂提供柔性化、自动化、智能化的焊接生产线，覆盖车身件、底盘件、白车身等 [1]。**Verified**

## Industries Served / 服务行业
**English:**
SKEQI serves the new energy (battery manufacturing), automotive and automotive parts, 3C electronics, aerospace, photovoltaic, energy storage, and specialised vehicle industries (e.g. forklifts) [1][3]. **Verified**

**中文：**
思客琦服务的行业包括新能源（电池制造）、汽车及汽车零部件、3C电子、航空航天、光伏、储能以及特种车辆（如叉车）等 [1][3]。**Verified**

## Customer Segments / 客户类型
**English:**
SKEQI’s customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers, new energy vehicle brands, photovoltaic and energy storage head enterprises, and special vehicle manufacturers [1][3]. Examples: lithium battery companies such as CATL (宁德时代), EVE Energy (亿纬锂能), CALB (中创新航), Gotion High-tech (国轩高科), REPT (瑞浦能源); automotive brands such as Audi, BMW, Ford, Geely, SAIC, XPeng (小鹏), Leapmotor (零跑); photovoltaic/energy storage companies such as Jinko Energy (晶科能源) and Hithium (海辰); and special vehicle manufacturers such as Linde and Hangcha (杭叉) [1][3]. **Verified** (first-party from the official website and third-party from the recruitment brochure)

**中文：**
思客琦的客户类型包括头部锂电池企业、新能源汽车品牌、光伏及储能头部企业以及特种车辆制造商 [1][3]。例如：宁德时代、亿纬锂能、中创新航、国轩高科、瑞浦能源等锂电池企业；奥迪、宝马、福特、吉利、上汽、小鹏、零跑等汽车品牌；晶科能源、海辰等光伏/储能企业；以及林德、杭叉等特种车辆企业 [1][3]。**Verified**（官网为第一方来源，招聘简章为第三方来源）

## Customers & Partners / 客户与合作伙伴
**English:**
**First-party source (official website):** SKEQI states its products have served CATL, EVE Energy, CALB, Gotion High-tech, XPeng, Leapmotor, and has provided electrification transition support to Linde and Hangcha [1].
**Third-party source (recruitment brochure):** Lists customers including CATL, CALB, EVE Energy, REPT, Audi, BMW, Ford, Geely, SAIC, Leapmotor, XPeng, Jinko Energy, Hithium [3].
No specific partner information is detailed in the evidence beyond the customer list. **Verified**

**中文：**
**第一方来源（官网）：** 思客琦表示其产品已服务于宁德时代、亿纬锂能、中创新航、国轩高科、小鹏、零跑，并为林德、杭叉提供电动化转型支持 [1]。
**第三方来源（招聘简章）：** 列出客户包括宁德时代、中创新航、亿纬锂能、瑞浦能源、奥迪、宝马、福特、吉利、上汽、零跑、小鹏、晶科能源、海辰等 [3]。
除客户列表外，证据中未披露具体的合作伙伴信息。**Verified**

## Differentiators / 差异化优势
**English:**
- **Market leadership:** Claims the No. 1 domestic market share for module and PACK production lines [3]. **Likely / partially supported** (stated in recruitment brochure, but specific year and ranking authority not provided).
- **Technology & R&D:** Possesses an established innovation system led by the IMATI (Intelligent Manufacturing Advanced Technology Institute), focusing on the deep integration of NDT, motion control, AI, 5G, robotics and vision applications [1]. Self-developed core technologies such as laser welding, energy control, laser shaping, and the 琦航 digital factory system [1].
- **Manufacturing scale:** 260,000 m² Ningde Phase II intelligent manufacturing base progressively coming into operation, enabling rapid response and efficient delivery [1].
- **One-stop solution:** Provides a full chain from intelligent equipment, digital software, intelligent logistics, laser applications, NDT, to precision manufacturing and automotive component lines, giving a broad integration capability [1].
- **Recognised excellence:** Won CATL’s “Best Equipment Quality Response Award” [1], and industry awards such as the Gaogong Lithium Battery Golden Ball Award and Gaogong Energy Storage awards [3]. **Verified**

**中文：**
- **市场领先地位：** 声称模组及PACK生产线国内市场占有率排名第一 [3]。**Likely / partially supported**（招聘简章中提及，但未提供具体年份和排名机构）。
- **技术与研发：** 拥有由智能制造先进技术研究院（IMATI）主导的科技创新体系，聚焦无损检测技术、运动控制技术、AI、5G、机器人及视觉应用的深度融合 [1]。自主研发激光焊接、能量控制、整形技术及琦航数字工厂系统等核心技术 [1]。
- **制造规模：** 26万㎡宁德二期智造基地逐步投产，实现快速响应与高效交付 [1]。
- **一站式解决方案：** 提供从智能装备、数字化软件、智能物流、激光应用、无损检测到精密制造和汽车零部件产线的完整链条，具备强大的整线集成能力 [1]。
- **卓越认可：** 荣获宁德时代“最佳设备质量响应奖” [1]，以及高工锂电金球奖、高工储能年度技术/年度企业等行业奖项 [3]。**Verified**

## Brand Values / 品牌价值观
**English:**
The official website displays the core values: “诚信 创新 责任 感恩” (Integrity, Innovation, Responsibility, Gratitude) [1]. **Verified**

**中文：**
官网展示的核心价值观为：“诚信 创新 责任 感恩” [1]。**Verified**

## Recent Developments / 近期动态
**English:**
- SKEQI won CATL’s “Best Equipment Quality Response Award” [1].
- Delivered a keynote speech on “Energy Storage Manufacturing Energy Efficiency Improvement Pathways” at the Gaogong Energy Storage Annual Conference (December 9) [1].
- Received the “Fifteen-Year Technology Leap” special award at the Gaogong Lithium Battery 15th Anniversary event (November 20) [1].
- 260,000 m² Ningde Phase II intelligent manufacturing base is gradually coming into production [1].
- A subsidiary, 宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司 (Ningde SKEQI Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.), obtained a patent for a “secondary positioning slide table for pre-stacking adhesive cells” (patent no. CN224662069U, application date September 2025, publication date around August 2026) [2]. **Verified**

**中文：**
- 思客琦荣获宁德时代“最佳设备质量响应奖” [1]。
- 在高工储能年会上发表“储能制造能效提升路径”主题演讲（12月9日）[1]。
- 在高工锂电十五周年庆典上荣获“十五年技术跃迁”特别奖项（11月20日）[1]。
- 26万㎡宁德二期智造基地逐步投产 [1]。
- 子公司宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司取得一项名为“一种贴胶电芯预堆叠二次定位滑台”的专利（授权公告号CN224662069U，申请日期2025年9月，公告日期约2026年8月）[2]。**Verified**
